messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

function.name: get_co_ordinate

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time) when both cities are on standard time (i.e., when daylight‑saving time is not in effect).  
When daylight‑saving time is observed, Los Angeles moves to UTC‑7 and Berlin to UTC+2, making the difference **10 hours**.

So:

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard time (winter) | UTC‑8 | UTC+1 | +9 h |
| Daylight‑saving time (summer) | UTC‑7 | UTC+2 | +10 h |

If you’re looking for the exact current offset, check whether each city is currently observing daylight‑saving time.
